name: UI/UX PRO
summary: Generate a complete, industry-tailored design system in seconds: 67 UI styles, 161 product-type reasoning rules, 57 font pairings, 161 color palettes, and stack-specific guidelines for 22 frameworks.
prevents: Generic AI-default UI, mismatched design language for the product type, manually hunting for color palettes and font pairings.

cursor.rule_description: Use when building any product UI — it matches the product type (SaaS, fintech, wellness, e-commerce, etc.) to the right style, colors, typography, and anti-patterns before any code is written.
cursor.skill_description: agentgrammar UI/UX PRO — 161-rule reasoning engine that generates a complete, industry-matched design system (style, colors, fonts, anti-patterns, checklist) for any product type. Use when the user invokes /agentgrammar-ui-ux-pro-max or asks for UI on a new product.
